title: Customers With A Cancelled Order
description:
Report the `name` of every customer who has at least one order with status `cancelled`.

Name the column `name`. Return the result in any order.
hint: Both the correlation (customer_id = c.id) and the extra filter (status = 'cancelled') live inside the same subquery.
outputExplanation: Only Bo has a cancelled order. Ada's orders are all completed and Cy's are completed or pending.

tests.name: Customer who never ordered
All orders cancelled
Orders with no items, products never sold
NULL prices, quantities and statuses
Single customer, single order
Ties in revenue between products and customers
Same-day repeat orders across month and year boundaries
No cancelled orders exist
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,'Ada','US','2021-01-01');
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,'2022-01-01','completed'),(2,1,'2022-01-02','pending');

tests.name: All orders are cancelled
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,'Ada','US','2021-01-01'),(2,'Bo','UK','2021-01-01');
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,'2022-01-01','cancelled'),(2,2,'2022-01-02','cancelled');

tests.name: Mixed — some customers have cancelled orders, others don't
Customer with multiple cancelled orders — listed once
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,'Ada','US','2021-01-01'),(2,'Bo','UK','2021-01-01');
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,'2022-01-01','cancelled'),(2,1,'2022-02-01','cancelled'),(3,2,'2022-03-01','completed');
